svg.title: Posterior confidence needs held-out reliability checks
svg.desc: Held-out calibration points are compared with the diagonal, beside world-level rates of false, reversed or absent sequential declarations. All points come from held-out synthetic worlds, separate from the illustrative world. The upper panel bins fixed day-180 probabilities for clearing a $0.02/lead margin buffer and compares average forecast probability with observed profitability. Error bars bootstrap independent worlds, not correlated rows; forecast and world counts are in the numeric table. The lower panel replays the first weekly 95%/5% declaration for the same purchased cohort in each world. “False profitable/unprofitable” compare that first declaration with the eventual day-180 outcome; “no declaration” is allowed; “later reversal” records changed classification after first declaration. Small world counts and approximate likelihoods limit the strength of calibration claims.
